issues.issue: Text says 'nonrandomized' but the cited quote only states 'open-label, single-center trial'; 'nonrandomized' is not in this citation (though supported elsewhere in the phase citation).

Text states '23% of the 13 responders had observed DOR of 6 months' — the 23% figure appears only in the prose citation without independent verification of the underlying count, but is cited; acceptable. However 'confirmed ORR 34%' with 13 responders (10 CR + 3 PR) is internally consistent and cited — no error.

The common-AE list omits several reactions present in the citation (erythema multiforme, urticaria, headache, injection site reaction, edema, anxiety, localized edema, irritability); under-inclusive summary but not a false claim.

Summary asserts a 'Rare Pediatric Disease Designation' as a granted designation; the citation supports it ('was granted a Rare Pediatric Disease Designation by FDA'), so it is cited — but this designation is not captured in any structured approval_program field, only in free-text summary.
